verdict.text: No meaningful difference among Static (B=2), Reactive and Predictive on p95, mean latency, throughput or failures under the pre-registered rule (SESOI + complete separation). Lowest p95 by point estimate: Predictive (81.3 ms), which is not a demonstrated advantage. Every controller selected B=2 in every decision and applied no configuration change, so the three arms ran the same configuration.

rule: a difference is MEANINGFUL only if |difference of arm means| > SESOI AND every comparable run of the worse arm is worse than every comparable run of the better arm (complete separation); otherwise NOT_DISTINGUISHABLE; when every cross-arm pair of runs differs by less than the SESOI the arms are EQUIVALENT_WITHIN_SESOI. With n=3 per arm no p-value below 0.10 exists, so no significance claim is made.
